title: Delivery failure notice bounced into the queue

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
Delivery has failed to these recipients or groups:

j.whitmore@northgate.example
The email address you entered could not be found. Please check the recipient's
address and try again.

Diagnostic information for administrators:
Remote server returned '550 5.1.10 RESOLVER.ADR.RecipientNotFound'

handling.escalation_reason: A bounce is a symptom of an earlier ticket, not a ticket; a person reconciles it.

rationale: The second noise shape, and the harder of the two: a bounce carries an error code, a recipient and diagnostic text, so it reads like a technical ticket and a classifier can find a confident email_collab label in it. It is not one - it is the tail of a reply the desk sent to a mailbox that no longer exists, and the right outcome is that somebody joins it back up to the ticket it came from.
